body.name: Allocation-regularized complete-schedule prior
body.construction: Draw \(V_a\) and \(U_i\) as specified, set \(P_a=1/2+\varepsilon_nV_a\), and form \(Y_i(a)=\mathbf 1\{U_i\le P_a\}\); the induced complete-schedule law is \(\Pi_{B,n}\). Define \(\Pi_n=(1-n^{-1/4})\Pi_{A,n}+n^{-1/4}\Pi_{B,n}\).
